prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1015; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for each. We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any surveillance or parking lot video in your possession. Our client has been receiving medical treatment for injuries sustained in the impact, and we will forward documentation of those treatments and related expenses once it is complete. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing.
